page.layout: One printed title page, centred, with several lines of display type. A library stamp and show-through from the reverse lie over the middle of the page.
page.notes: The middle lines are faint and partly hidden by the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München stamp and by show-through from the reverse, so they could not be read. The imprint lines at the foot are also faint; the place, printer and date are my best reading and should be checked against the scan. The date may read differently, for example CIↃ IↃ CXXIII. The blue stamps and the blue edge at the bottom are not transcribed.
